# DefinitionIssue

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One problem found in a definition, located by JSON Pointer (RFC 6901).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

## Properties

- [`code`](#code): A stable, kebab-case code.
- [`expected`](#expected): What the definition should have contained here, when that can be stated.
- [`found`](#found): What the definition contained instead, when that can be stated.
- [`id`](#id): The `id` of the element the problem is in, when it has one.
- [`message`](#message): English text for a person.
- [`path`](#path): JSON Pointer to the value at fault; `''` is the whole document.
- [`since`](#since): The definition format version that introduced the thing the issue is about, when relevant.
